name: aiic
description: Three analysis skills distilled from course material: deep-thinking works a question through four passes (gut answer, breadth and depth, comparison across places and time, abstraction) to reach root causes and transferable patterns; demand-analysis breaks a product idea into user × scenario × motivation and judges key factors, barriers, Why NOW and Why ME; market-sizing estimates annual market size as breadth × intensity × frequency, with a bundled calculator.
